fields.summary: The district is using the second of two one-year renewal options with Apex Refrigeration, doing business as Pelco Sales and Service, for refrigerator maintenance and equipment repairs for Nutrition Services. The services and the not-to-exceed amount of $447,000 are unchanged, and the renewal runs July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027. The official text misprints the amount as "$447,00.00"; the attached summary shows $447,000.00.

26-0958.sourceIssue: The unchanged contract amount is printed as "$447,00.00", which is missing a digit; the attached board summary gives it as $447,000.00.
